impact: Tier 2 and all later tiers remain unscreened; no primary cohort can be frozen.
problem: The frozen protocol requires Tier 2 candidates to have an existing reproducible upstream security regression test or exploit, but it does not define a bounded deterministic discovery procedure or an absence criterion for that repository-wide property.
prohibited_post_freeze_shortcut: Treating the absence of a test-file change in the fixing-commit patch as proof that no existing upstream witness exists would add a new eligibility rule after protocol freeze and can produce false negatives.
resolution_required: Create and freeze a successor prospective protocol that specifies exact witness-search inputs, history bounds, path and metadata rules, deterministic ordering, network-failure handling, and the evidence required to declare no witness before resuming with a newly frozen cohort selection.
